svg.title: NusaRide: Car, Hiace and bus rentals with per-unit availability, a fleet admin, PDF invoices, two languages and two themes.
svg.desc: Project card for NusaRide, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts scrolling. Car, Hiace and bus rentals with per-unit availability, a fleet admin, PDF invoices, two languages and two themes. Built with React 19, React Router, Tailwind v4, jsPDF.
